# llms.txt - AI discoverability for yamuna-b.vercel.app

> Yamuna B's personal portfolio.

Yamuna B is a Backend / Cloud Engineer with AI specialization from Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India. She is a final-year Computer Science student at Velammal College of Engineering and Technology (Graduating 2027). She builds practical software including REST APIs, database systems, AWS cloud deployments, and GenAI features.

## Main Links
- [Home](https://yamuna-b.vercel.app): Portfolio homepage with projects, skills, work experience, achievements, and contact details.
- [Projects](https://yamuna-b.vercel.app/#projects): Portfolio of software systems built with Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, React, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and AWS.

## Featured Projects
- [MoneyMirror](https://github.com/Yamuna-b/Money_Mirror): Personal finance digital twin built with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Docker, GitHub Actions, and Hugging Face.
- [LogBeacon](https://github.com/Yamuna-b/LogBeacon): Structured log analysis backend supporting filtering, incident linking, and summarization built with React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Zod, and Vercel/Render.
- [MarineTaxaAi](https://github.com/Yamuna-b/MarineTaxaAi): eDNA sequence classification pipeline for marine species prediction using Python, FastAPI, Streamlit, scikit-learn, NumPy, pandas, Biopython, and Plotly.
- [NammaOorFix](https://github.com/Yamuna-b/NammaOorFix): Civic issue reporting portal with React/Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT, and geospatial clustering.
- [Realtime Support Chat](https://github.com/Yamuna-b/client-support-realtime-chat): Real-time helpdesk chat widget built with Node.js, Express, Socket.io, and Firebase.
